9-panel sheet, THREE rows rooms, THREE columns strict TOP plan / FRONT orthographic cutaway / RIGHT orthographic cutaway. Row B FACET HALL 18x14, shallow fan footprint with broad inner chord, two wall mirror alcoves containing angular copper-framed opaque violet mirrors. Row C HANGING EYE COURT 18x17 asymmetric three-lobed footprint, two wide lateral routes, eye-shaped crystals on side pedestals. Show subtle one-unit grid, same footprint in three views, dimensions labels. Walls 3.2 units tall, 1 unit thick. Observational rings outside wall, not in routes.
source: a Markdown image or file link.
